steps.title: Analyze Audio Feedback Requirements
steps.description: Assess user request for adding 4 distinct tap sound synthesizer profiles within the advanced audio generation code.

steps.title: Design 4 Core Synthesizer Presets
steps.description: Map out specific DSP synthesis algorithms: LASER (fast pitch sweep down), BLIP (retro square wave pulse), POP (organic triangle wave sweep), and COSMIC (dual-oscillator ring modulated tone).

steps.title: Incorporate Sound Preset State Management
steps.description: Add member variables and key constants to persist the currently selected sound preset index via SharedPreferences.

steps.title: Extend Main Activity UI Layout
steps.description: Incorporate a dedicated layout button 'btn_action_sound_preset' in the main horizontal controls block of activity_main.xml.

steps.title: Bind Sound Cycle UI Elements
steps.description: Initialize the newly introduced sound preset button inside onCreate and register listeners using Java 8 anonymous inner classes.

steps.title: Build playPresetSound Routing Method
steps.description: Construct background thread logic to safely execute real-time sample buffer generation for each of the 4 sound presets.

steps.title: Create playCosmicTone Ring Modulation Oscillator
steps.description: Implement double frequency FM synthesis inside playCosmicTone to produce metallic sci-fi ringing tones using clean mathematical algorithms.

steps.title: Sync Tap Actions with Selected Sound
steps.description: Route main tapping click sound callbacks and bubble pops through the newly engineered preset system.

steps.title: Update Display Metrics Rendering
steps.description: Format sound preset text indicators on UI labels cleanly as the cycle loops between LASER, BLIP, POP, and COSMIC.

steps.title: Ensure Smooth UI Theme Consistency
steps.description: Configure the sound preset button's gradient style to match dynamic transitions in Neon Indigo, Cyber Sunset, Mint Aurora, and Electric Crimson themes.

steps.title: Perform Thread-Safety Audits
steps.description: Verify background worker threads safely encapsulate high-latency AudioTrack sound calculations to keep main thread interactions fluent.

steps.title: Verify Local Compilation Safety
steps.description: Ensure no lambdas or streams were introduced, guaranteeing optimal local compilation inside Android SDK environment with Java 1.8.

steps.title: Building Simple Tap Counter
steps.description: Compile raw resources and build scripts to generate high-performance diagnostic APK assets with rich dual-oscillator sound capability.
